# Create RN App

# Introduction to SeaTalk cli tools

SeaTalk cli tools allows you to create, manage, upload your RN Apps and Web Apps with a single line of code with the following steps:

1. Set local npm registry
2. Create project
3. Init Project
4. Run Project

![](data:image/png;base64,)

# 1\. Set local npm registry

Change your npm registry into seagroup registry, like this command:`npm config set registry https://npm.sea.com/`, or you can use`nrm`to conveniently manage your npm registry.

![](data:image/png;base64,)

# 2\. Create project

When creating project, you can choose either to use`create-seatalk-app`package remotely or install and run it locally

* **Create RN or Web App project to local repository using remote package**

**npx**:

```bash
npx create-seatalk-app <app-name> Copy
```

**yarn**:

```bash
yarn create seatalk-app <app-name> Copy
```

**npm**:

```bash
npm init seatalk-app <app-name> Copy
```

* **Create RN or Web App project to local repository using locally installed package**

```bash
# install package in your local environment only once
npm install create-seatalk-app -g

# after completing the above step, you can use the local plugin to create project
create-seatalk-app <app-name> Copy
```

# 3\. Init project

```bash
The init project steps are as follows:
1. set app name
2. set app type(web app|rn app)
3. set app appid Copy
```

# 4\. Run project

```bash
cd <app-name>

# We recommend using `yarn` to install packages, if you prefer npm to yarn that you can use `npm install` instead.
yarn install

# The same as above, `npm start` instead.
yarn start Copy
```

![](data:image/png;base64,)

# 5\. Local develop

After testing the project, you can follow these two article to develop your RN or Web App

1. [Web App](/docs/functions_introduction)
2. [RN App](/docs/get-leave-balance-report_get-started)
